sources.title: Git diff-format — Generating patch text with -p
sources.facts: Patch headers identify a/ and b/ paths, even on additions/deletions; extended headers include old/new mode and new/deleted file mode. Header paths therefore provide identity independently of textual hunks.

sources.title: Git official diff.c source
sources.facts: The upstream producer builds a path header before mode metadata. must_show_header emits metadata for additions, deletions, and mode changes even if text has no changes. Binary branches emit the path header and a binary notice without textual hunks.
sources.limitations: Read-only upstream master snapshot; no installed Git version was executed or claimed. Synthetic patch strings were passed to the actual CodeShell parser.
